# Vow

> Vow is a programming language built for AI agents to write. Every compiler and runtime error says what is wrong, where, and gives a "Likely fix" line to act on. There is no null and there are no exceptions: anything that can fail returns a Result (`ok(v)` or `err(msg)`) that must be handled with `match` or `?`. Functions that touch the network, files or environment declare `uses net`, `uses fs` or `uses env`. Types are inferred, so programs carry no annotations. Vow compiles to JavaScript and needs only Node.js 20 or newer.

Before writing Vow, read the language guide below in full. Install with `npm install -g github:JakeBurwick/vow`, run a program with `vow file.vow`, and after every edit run `vow --check file.vow` and apply each error's "Likely fix".

## Docs

- [Vow language guide](https://vow-lang.vercel.app/bench/VOW_GUIDE.md): the complete language in one file, written for an agent to learn Vow in one read
- [Verified examples](https://vow-lang.vercel.app/bench/EXAMPLES.md): working programs that passed the benchmark judge, showing Results, match, maps, JSON and recursion
- [AGENTS.md template](https://vow-lang.vercel.app/templates/AGENTS.md): drop into a project root so a coding agent picks up the rules automatically

## Install and CLI

- [Install and command-line flags](https://github.com/JakeBurwick/vow#install): `vow app.vow`, `vow --check app.vow`, `vow test app.vow`, `vow --sandbox --allow fs=./data app.vow`, `vow --seed 7 app.vow`
- [MCP server](https://github.com/JakeBurwick/vow/tree/main/mcp): `vow-mcp` gives an agent vow_guide, vow_check, vow_run and vow_test tools; in Claude Code run `claude mcp add vow -- vow-mcp`

## Optional

- [Tutorial](https://vow-lang.vercel.app/#learn): 12 short lessons for people, each runnable in the browser
- [Source repository](https://github.com/JakeBurwick/vow): compiler, CLI, benchmarks and example programs
